What's your return and refund policy?
14:09
Here is a clear overview of how our returns and refunds work:
Return window
Full-price items: Return within 30 days of receipt in original condition for a refund to your original payment method.
Sale items: Register your return within 14 days of receipt, then you have a further 14 days to send it back, in original condition.
How to start a return
Use our online returns partner to register your return and create your label: Start a return with our returns partner (opens in a new tab)
Cost of returns
Returns are free within the UK.
Items that cannot be refunded
Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed.
Earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Discounts and offers
Discounts are applied per item. Any item you keep keeps its discount. Returned items are refunded at the price you paid after the discount.
Pre-orders and mixed orders
If you return an item from an order that still has an outstanding pre-order, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund. Any remaining balance is refunded to your original payment method.
Exchanges
We do not offer exchanges. Please return the item for a refund and place a new order online for the replacement.
365-day quality guarantee
After the standard return period (or 14 days for sale items), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived.
Within 6 months of receipt for faulty items: we will refund your item.
